TC-14/S15.title: Bedside checks stay reminders and doses already given are documented as done, not re-ordered (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home)
TC-14/S15.detail: Dataset gen-notes-b on dev (live Haiku 4.5), through the app's UI. 6/10 pass: FAILED (below 9/10; Q2 would only make it stricter). AC 8 (a medication already given is documented as done): H-11 'Restart metoprolol tartrate 25 mg PO BID (held since Oct 14 …; restarted this morning …)' and H-15 'Atrial fibrillation — restart apixaban 5 mg PO BID (held for procedure, restarted this morning)' put the restart in the plan as an order; N-12 documents the one-time acetaminophen 650 as given but adds '1. Administer acetaminophen as needed for knee pain.' (an order nobody dictated). Together with TC-14/S01 on dev ('Restart metoprolol tartrate 25 mg PO BID') all 3 Hospital 'restarted … this morning' dictations of this package (S01, H-11, H-15) end with a restart order in the plan; none of the 3 Nursing Home ones (S02, N-11, N-15) do. AC 7 (bedside check stays a reminder): N-15 'Look at the left foot wound again on Friday' → 'Continue monitoring wound healing and glucose trends.' ('wound healing' is on the fixture's finding list; the plan also has 'Reassess left foot wound on Friday'). The other 6 (H-12, H-13, H-14, N-11, N-13, N-14) keep the check a reminder and the given dose done.
TC-14/S15.productIssue: A medication the physician already restarted this morning appears in the note's plan as 'Restart metoprolol …' / 'restart apixaban …', and a one-time dose turns into a new PRN order: read as orders they could lead to a double dose.
